items.name: form-summary

items.name: sidebar

items.name: combobox

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: Keyboard-first modal command launcher that filters and runs commands, built on Base UI Dialog with motion enter/exit.

items.name: searchable-results
items.title: Searchable Results
items.description: Controlled search field with a results list, query highlighting and honest loading, empty and load-more states.

items.name: split-pane
items.title: Split Pane
items.description: Two-panel layout with a pointer- and keyboard-operable divider whose panel sizes stay clamped to valid bounds.

items.name: search-and-results
items.title: Search and Results
items.description: Search field, filter layer and honest results region composed from Searchable Results, Select, Checkbox, Badge and Alert, with dismissible filter chips and a `/` focus shortcut.

items.name: settings-section
items.title: Settings Section
items.description: Data-driven settings form with text, textarea, select, switch and checkbox fields, inline validation, dirty tracking and honest save, pending and error states.

items.name: process-monitor
items.title: Process Monitor
items.description: Multi-stage task monitor pairing an ordered stage list, a truthful progress bar and a scrollable log with terminal cancel, retry and dismiss actions.

items.name: resource-explorer
items.title: Resource Explorer
items.description: Hierarchical tree browser with roving focus, type-ahead, inline rename and keyboard reorder actions as an accessible alternative to drag and drop.

items.name: data-details-workspace
items.title: Data Details Workspace
items.description: Sortable list-and-detail workspace that places the Table in a Split Pane and keeps the selected row visible while the divider moves or the layout stacks.

items.name: guided-form
items.title: Guided Form
items.description: Multi-step form shell with per-step validation, an error summary that links back to fields, draft save and restore and a truthfully loading submit.

items.name: media-document
items.title: Media Document
items.description: Renderer-neutral composition document: typed artboard, layers, fonts and assets, deterministic serialization and validation, locale-aware text layout, and dependency-free SVG/PNG export with explicit fidelity diagnostics.

items.name: artboard
items.title: Artboard
items.description: Fixed-size design surface with explicit dimensions, background, safe region, bleed and crop, publishing a shared design-space context for authoring-time zoom, pan and selection.

items.name: editable-text
items.title: Editable Text
items.description: Composable text layer with styled spans, measured glyph runs, a deterministic wrap/shrink/clip/fit policy, locale and bidirectional support, pinned font fallback and text-as-text output.

items.name: media-frame
items.title: Media Frame
items.description: Places a referenced image, video or vector inside a layer box with explicit fit, focal point, mask and crop, without ever mutating the source asset's intrinsic dimensions.

items.name: layer-stack
items.title: Layer Stack
items.description: Ordered layer composition with stable ids, grouping, visibility, locking, opacity, blending and rectangular clipping, plus an accessible layer tree for selection, visibility and reordering.

items.name: alignment-guides
items.title: Alignment Guides
items.description: Non-exporting authoring overlay for grid, guides, safe region, centre axes, live measurements and snap feedback, sharing the pure snapping model with the document.

items.name: export-preview
items.title: Export Preview
items.description: Preview, inspect and export a composition at its output size, with bleed and crop, small-format inspection, missing-font and missing-asset warnings and downloadable SVG and PNG deliverables that match the preview byte for byte.

items.name: infographic-system
items.title: Infographic System
items.description: Dependency-free engine that turns a validated semantic InfographicSource into a renderer-neutral primitive layout: source schema, validation and content digests, deterministic text measurement and content requirements, editorial and bento grids, information blocks, structure visualizers, one shared chart grammar, the template catalog, the layout engine and static SVG/PNG export.

items.name: infographic-view
items.title: Infographic View
items.description: Deterministic DOM preview that draws a resolved infographic layout as accessible SVG, owning no layout, measurement or art direction so it cannot drift from the static exporter.

items.name: infographic-economic-charts
items.title: Economic Charts
items.description: CostWaterfall, LifecycleCostTimeline, BreakEvenComparison and ScenarioBand on the infographic primitive engine: exact minor-unit reconciliation, declared currency basis and cadence (never converted), missing values distinct from zero, event markers aligned to authored dates, truthful crossover analysis (interpolated, at jumps, within ties, bracketed in gaps) with payback only under an authored definition, declared band meaning (range vs stated interval) with actual vs projected values, frame-addressed reveals, 16:9/9:16 layouts, text-collision guard and an accessible SVG view/exporter.

items.name: motion-track
items.title: Motion Track
items.description: Dependency-free motion kernel that evaluates a validated timeline of typed, keyframed tracks, sequences, staggers and constraints into renderer-neutral samples at an explicit frame, plus schema validation, tolerant parsing and stable JSON serialization.

items.name: motion-path
items.title: Motion Path
items.description: Renderer-neutral motion paths that flatten anchors into an arc-length-parameterised polyline and expose point, tangent and angle sampling, bounds, SVG `d` serialization and deterministic trim windows.

items.name: mask-reveal
items.title: Mask Reveal
items.description: Deterministic clip, alpha and luma matte resolver that sweeps a declaration rect along a chosen axis at a given progress, with feathering, stable compositing order and a declared capability fallback per matte kind.

items.name: shape-morph
items.title: Shape Morph
items.description: Contour shape morphing that validates compatibility, resamples rings deterministically and interpolates between two shapes, with explicit dissolve and cut fallbacks when contours cannot morph.

items.name: shared-element
items.title: Shared Element
items.description: Durable cross-cut element handoff that interpolates transform and opacity across a declared handoff range under cross-fade, cut or hold-old collision policies, with validation and contact queries.

items.name: motion-preset
items.title: Motion Preset
items.description: Constructive motion preset catalog that expands a declarative preset instance into concrete timeline nodes for fade, rise, pop, slide, kinetic and exit intents, with versioning, declared parameters and materialization diagnostics.

items.name: animated-text
items.title: Animated Text
items.description: Deterministic kinetic-text builder that segments a string into grapheme, word or line tokens and staggers a materialized preset across them, returning an evaluable timeline plus glyph ids and diagnostics.

items.name: scene-storyboard
items.title: Scene Storyboard
items.description: Serializable shot planner that orders shots across the composition timeline, validates continuity, handoffs, cues and coverage without throwing, and exposes clips, cues and timeline nodes for placement.

items.name: exploded-view
items.title: Exploded View 3D
items.description: Reversible hierarchical part separation with parent/local/world offsets, custom part/environment factories and camera-projected occlusion-aware annotations.

items.name: diagram-stage
items.title: Diagram Stage
items.description: Frame-addressable graph layouts with stable node/port identity, attached cubic connectors, arc-length data packets and customizable SVG rendering slots.

items.name: storyboard-shots
items.title: Storyboard Shots
items.description: Shared active-shot explanation and keyboard-operable shot navigation for a frame-addressed storyboard.

items.name: progressive-reveal
items.title: Progressive Reveal
items.description: Cue-addressable staged entrances and emphasis holds compiled to existing MG1 presets, with shared DOM and SVG composition slots.

items.name: camera-pose-3d
items.title: 3D Camera Pose
items.description: General quaternion and perspective/orthographic poses baked into existing MG1 channels; no engine import.

items.name: cinematic-camera-director
items.title: Cinematic Camera Director
items.description: Declarative semantic shots, world targets, bounded composition constraints and continuous quaternion handoffs compiled to MG1; optional Three.js preview.

items.name: camera-rig-3d
items.title: 3D Camera Rig
items.description: Renderer-independent orbit, dolly, crane, tracking, lens and roll choreography compiled to existing MG1 tracks.

items.name: camera-viewport-3d
items.title: 3D Camera Viewport
items.description: Optional Three.js perspective viewport with absolute-frame camera evaluation, scene lifecycle, fixed overlays and WebGL recovery.

items.name: camera-stage
items.title: Camera Stage
items.description: Frame-addressable SVG camera with pan, zoom, roll, cuts, subject fitting and screen-space overlays, compiled to existing MG1 tracks.

items.name: cut-director
items.title: Cut Director
items.description: Compiles shots and cuts, match cuts, punch-ins, whip pans, masked or foreground wipes, dissolves and holds into a frame-addressable 2D shot plan over existing MG1 cameras and masks; checks identity and framing at every boundary, disables transitions cleanly and applies reduced-motion fallbacks without changing timing.

items.name: visual-transformation
items.title: Visual Transformation
items.description: Semantic 2D scene transformations compiled to MG1 tracks, explicit strategy fallbacks, immutable interruption history, seven reusable recipes and a frame-driven SVG adapter.

items.name: motion-director
items.title: Motion Director
items.description: Declarative choreography compiler over MG1: dependency-checked timing, joined property channels, shots, VT1 handoffs, typed cue metadata, seven parameterized recipes and aspect-specific scene presets. No clock or renderer engine.

items.name: motion-director-react
items.title: Motion Director React
items.description: Clock-free MotionDirector render boundary, shared MG1 samples, reduced-motion final composition and typed narration, speech, SFX and music cue hooks.

items.name: motion-react
items.title: Motion React
items.description: Render stage, motion box, kinetic text, vector draw, shape morph, mask reveal and scrubber components plus evaluation hooks that are pure functions of an explicit frame prop, owning reduced-motion handling and accessible labels.

items.name: explainer-stage
items.title: Explainer Stage
items.description: Measured essential text in safe regions around named protected subjects, with responsive portrait/landscape composition and explicit impossible-layout diagnostics.

items.name: short-safe-frame
items.title: Short Safe Frame
items.description: Per-output reserved regions (app UI, caption lanes) for independently composed 9:16 and 16:9 frames: content area, CC1 and text-placement bridges, collision checks, blind-crop detection and a non-exporting simulated-UI preview.

items.name: caption-performer
items.title: Caption Performer
items.description: Supplied timed captions at an absolute frame: optional aligned word highlighting, emphasis, speaker labels, CJK/RTL wrapping between aligned units, measured blocks placed in a safe lane around reserved UI, and diagnostics for late, overlapping, mismatched or unsupported timings. CaptionStage is the static mode.

items.name: short-hook-director
items.title: Short Hook Director
items.description: Compiles action-first, unexpected-reveal, impact-statistic, transformation and evidence-question openings into an ordinary MotionDirector group plus a hook plan; validates the payoff shot against the production contract, frame-0 visibility on the compiled timeline and frame-0 framing per output.

items.name: semantic-composition
items.title: Semantic Composition
items.description: Compile MD1 event-linked actions, CC1 subject projection, critical visibility and measured explainer framing without duplicating camera or motion clocks.

items.name: crafted-3d
items.title: Crafted 3D Components
items.description: Optional physically based material kit with deterministic surface microstructure, studio lights and a detailed modular hardware enclosure with semantic ports.

items.name: crafted-3d-hero
items.title: Crafted 3D Hero Toolkit
items.description: Domain-agnostic hero-asset toolkit: deterministic SDF sculpting with projected surface nets and baked cavity occlusion, shader micro-surface detail for UV-less meshes, physically motivated sculpt finishes (aged bronze, gold, ceramic, natural coat), eyelid/eyeball anatomy, painted canvas textures with relief, an HDR product studio with cyclorama, and a frame-addressable React viewer.

items.name: explainer-principles
items.title: Explainer Principles
items.description: CPU-only preflight for explainer productions: declared shot purposes, identity continuity, frame-0 subjects, hook payoff, readable holds, independently authored outputs, text versus reserved UI, capabilities, licences, sourced facts and seek parity.

items.name: explainer-production
items.title: Explainer Production
items.description: Declarative CC1/MD1-linked explainer sequence with opt-in SD1/XP1 preflight, shared-frame preview, action contracts, explicit closing summary and deterministic capture readiness.

items.name: semantic-motion-direction
items.title: Semantic Motion Direction
items.description: Renderer-independent semantic scene contracts, intention-bound transfers, measured label placement and fast screenshot-free preflight.

items.name: domain-metric-model
items.title: Finance and Business Metric Data
items.description: Validated semantic data for trends, waterfall bridges and conversion funnels; zero-policy and exact accounting, shared by 2D and 3D.

items.name: domain-metric-2d
items.title: Finance and Business 2D Visuals
items.description: Frame-driven premium SVG finance and business visuals from one validated domain contract, with round axis ticks, proportional funnel flow bands and measured, group-consistent labels for long and CJK text.

items.name: domain-metric-3d
items.title: Finance and Business 3D Visuals
items.description: Data-faithful Three.js chart geometry with real materials, CC1 camera framing, frame-driven reveals and readable HUD.

items.name: video-export-stage
items.title: Video Export Stage
items.description: Frame-accurate export handshake for any 2D/3D Storybook explainer; shared manifest and capture surface for browser-to-MP4 export.

items.name: domain-finance-object-model
items.title: Finance and Business Object Vocabulary
items.description: Stable semantic identity for 61 named bank, payment, cash, loan, market and business objects grouped into 26 archetypes.

items.name: domain-object-model
items.title: Domain Object Vocabulary Contract
items.description: Renderer-neutral kind-to-archetype vocabulary validation and absolute-frame reveal shared by domain object packs.

items.name: domain-illustration-2d
items.title: Domain Illustration Toolkit (2D)
items.description: Dependency-free SVG illustration kit: semantic color tokens, lit material gradients with useId-scoped defs, keyline and radius scales, plates, sheets, screens, coins, cylinders, badges, icons, measured title band, reduced-motion reveal and an accessible frame.

items.name: domain-finance-objects-2d
items.title: Finance and Business SVG Objects
items.description: Per-kind 2D SVG illustrations for 61 finance and business concepts (bank, card, ATM, documents, cash, markets and more) composed from the shared illustration toolkit; themeable tokens and a configurable currency symbol.

items.name: domain-finance-hero-3d
items.title: Finance Hero 3D Assets
items.description: Crafted hero-tier finance assets: sculpted bull and bear (aged bronze or natural), banknotes and banded cash, proof coins, cast gold bars, money bag, payment cards and a neoclassical bank. Original anonymous designs; no real currency, issuer or network marks.

items.name: domain-finance-objects-3d
items.title: Finance and Business 3D Objects
items.description: Finance and business 3D objects with CC1-framed exportable React viewer; kinds with crafted hero assets (bull/bear, cash, coins, gold, money bag, cards, bank) render through domain-finance-hero-3d.

items.name: domain-business-object-model
items.title: Business Object Vocabulary
items.description: Seventeen business operations concepts (org chart, team, meeting, presentation, KPI dashboard, target, milestone, deadline, workflow, checklist, idea, announcement, global market, delivery truck, shipping box, warehouse, factory) mapped to 12 archetypes.

items.name: domain-business-objects-2d
items.title: Business SVG Objects
items.description: Brand-free 2D SVG illustrations for every business kind, composed from the shared illustration toolkit with themeable tokens and an accessible frame.

items.name: domain-technology-object-model
items.title: Technology Object Vocabulary
items.description: Eighteen vendor-neutral technology concepts (server rack, router, database, storage disk, cloud, API connector, laptop, mobile phone, processor, AI model, security lock, security key, code terminal, container, user identity, settings, software bug, version branch) mapped to 15 archetypes.

items.name: domain-technology-objects-2d
items.title: Technology SVG Objects
items.description: Vendor-neutral 2D SVG illustrations for every technology kind, composed from the shared illustration toolkit with themeable tokens and an accessible frame.

items.name: video-platform-presets
items.title: Social Video Platform Presets
items.description: Versioned YouTube, Shorts, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn export dimensions, timing and safe-area guidance.

items.name: frame-accurate-clip
items.title: Frame Accurate Clip
items.description: Deterministic footage: maps every output frame to an exact source frame (trim, rate, reverse, freezes, time remap, variable frame rate), reframes per output, and draws through capability-advertising adapters (image sequence, procedural, per-frame-verified browser video, or your own decoder) with visible errors instead of substitutes.

items.name: audio-visual-cue
items.title: Audio Visual Cue
items.description: Joins absolute-frame visual events to narration words, segments, music beats and sound effects: neutral word-timing format with parsers for WhisperX, OpenAI Whisper, Gentle, aeneas, MFA TextGrid, SRT/WebVTT and TTS character timings (or your own), late/early/missing link diagnostics, visual-only mode, caption-track and MotionDirector bridges, and a film-length FFmpeg mix manifest.

items.name: freeze-frame-focus
items.title: Freeze Frame Focus
items.description: Recipe that pauses footage or animation on an exact frame, pushes in on a tracked source-pixel annotation with a spotlight, explains it with measured callouts, then releases and resumes; refuses untracked details and reports upscaling or cropped details per output.

items.name: domain-finance-object-review
items.title: Finance Object Reference Review
items.description: Reference URLs and review status for each finance/business 3D object; not an automatic photorealism claim.

items.name: crafted-3d-quality
items.title: 3D Asset Quality Contracts
items.description: Deterministic, renderer-free checks for physical hero asset structure and manually reviewed photo evidence metadata.

items.name: craft-part-rig
items.title: Part Rig
items.description: Deterministic posing of separately animatable named parts in any Three.js hierarchy: translate, rotate about a pivot, scale, opacity (material clones, nested fades multiply) and visibility layered over an asset's own actions.

items.name: inspectable-asset
items.title: Inspectable Asset
items.description: Renderer-neutral adapter contract for 2D/3D assets: semantic part tree, frame-addressed bounds and anchors, states and declared capabilities, with structural diagnostics, a camera-target bridge and an SVG adapter for tagged part groups.

items.name: inspectable-asset-three
items.title: Inspectable Asset (Three.js)
items.description: Inspect any HeroAsset through InspectableAsset: measured per-frame mesh bounds and anchors that follow moving parts. Existing hero assets need no changes.

items.name: domain-home-model
items.title: Home Model
items.description: Renderer-neutral house spec, presets and validated layout plus customizable interiors: floor plans (rooms tiling the footprint, connections), derived walls and doors, furniture recipes with per-room overrides, electrical, yards, walk map and room tours; service routes for ducts, line set, water and rain.

items.name: domain-home-3d
items.title: Home Kit 3D
items.description: Crafted layered 3D houses from a HouseSpec: envelope, structure and systems plus furnished interiors (partitions, interior doors, ~40 furniture/fixture kinds, appliances, lights, outlets) and yards; every room, item and moving sub-part (doors, drawers, appliance doors) a separately animatable group with frame-addressed actions; stand-alone equipment HeroAssets (condenser with fan and status light, air handler, tank and tankless water heaters with valve pivots and a display); a buildable snowman yard prop.

items.name: section-reveal
items.title: Section Reveal
items.description: Look inside intact assemblies without moving parts: isolate, ghost, sweeping section and capped section planned per absolute frame over any InspectableAsset, with explicit fallbacks and diagnostics; includes the SVG isolate/ghost adapter.

items.name: section-reveal-three
items.title: Section Reveal (Three.js)
items.description: Applies SectionReveal frames to Three.js assets: per-mesh fades, world-space clipping planes on material clones and approximate stencil caps colored from real material albedo.

items.name: semantic-callouts
items.title: Semantic Callout Layer
items.description: Labels and leaders attached to moving semantic parts: per-frame anchors from InspectableAsset, measured CJK-safe wrapping, collision-free placement around protected regions/parts, and honest visible/occluded/outside/unplaceable status; SVG overlay included.

items.name: semantic-callouts-three
items.title: Semantic Callouts (Three.js)
items.description: Exact HeroAssetViewer camera reconstruction, projection and depth-aware ray-cast occlusion for SemanticCalloutLayer.

items.name: flow-path
items.title: Flow Path
items.description: Illustrative directional flow along 2D/3D polylines or MG1 motion paths: arrows, streaks, particles, ribbon or pulse, pure per absolute frame with capped markers, seeded per-particle jitter, draw-on, reversal and honest measured-vs-illustrative magnitude; SVG renderer included.

items.name: flow-path-three
items.title: Flow Path (Three.js)
items.description: Three.js FlowPath adapter: draw-on tube track, fixed-capacity instanced markers and a phase-driven ribbon.

items.name: comparison-stage
items.title: Comparison Stage
items.description: Fair side-by-side comparisons of 2D or 3D subjects: renderer-neutral slot layout from real-world extents with one shared px-per-meter and ground line (equal) or declared per-slot fit with ratio badges and scale bars (fit-each), measurements in metric or imperial, tiny-subject diagnostics, matched HeroAssetViewer cameras solved to the planned box with reported perspective residual, and a React view with real-text labels.

items.name: asset-state-sequence
items.title: Asset State Sequence
items.description: Frame-addressed transitions between an asset's supplied states: variant builds (e.g. new/aged/damaged) and pose states driven by real actions; interpolate only where the same build supports it, otherwise explicit crossfade, wipe or cut with transition-fallback diagnostics; unknown states fail at compile time; pure evaluation for any seek order.

items.name: asset-state-sequence-three
items.title: Asset State Sequence (Three.js)
items.description: Composite HeroAsset over supplied variant builds with a single `sequence` action: overlay crossfades for same-shape variants, hashed-alpha dissolves for different shapes, clip-plane wipes, interpolated action poses, unit normalization by metersPerUnit and lazy material clones restored after each transition.

items.name: animated-metric
items.title: Animated Metric
items.description: Deterministic count-ups and changing quantities: currency, percent and unit formats with one precision per metric, interpolate only between known keyframes (MG1 easing) or step for discrete facts, exact rest values, flagged in-between frames, unknown values never zero, change badges colored by declared good direction, and a width reserve so layouts do not jitter.

items.name: measure-units
items.title: Measure Units
items.description: Length, area and angle text from meters in metric or imperial: millimeters and sixteenth-inch fractions for thin layers, ft/in, m²/ft² and roof pitch (rise:12 with degrees).

items.name: dimension-overlay
items.title: Dimension Overlay
items.description: Dimensions, thickness chains, areas, angles and person/bar scale references resolved from asset meters (InspectableAsset anchors and part bounds, or authored values with sources and mismatch checks), projected through any 2D/3D projector with draw-on, upright labels, thin-layer label stacks with leaders, collision avoidance, foreshortening and unplaceable diagnostics; SVG renderer included.

items.name: domain-home-dimensions
items.title: Home Dimensions
items.description: Measured DimensionOverlay specs for a HouseLayout from the same model the 3D build uses: envelope, wall and roof layer stacks, foundation depth, window opening, roof pitch, footprint area and a person for scale.

items.name: mechanism-sequence
items.title: Mechanism Sequence
items.description: Frame-addressed operations on moving parts: rotate/slide with limits, declared part motions, continuous spins with spin-up/down integrated in closed form (real vs visual rpm reported), toggles; after-dependencies with cycle detection, limit clamping and overlap diagnostics; pure per frame.

items.name: mechanism-sequence-three
items.title: Mechanism Sequence (Three.js)
items.description: Applies mechanism joint values to an asset's pivot objects over captured rest transforms: local-axis rotations, spins and slides, declared userData.motion, visibility or emissive toggles; missing pivots fail with the available part list.

items.name: environmental-effects
items.title: Environmental Effects
items.description: Seeded, bounded, always-illustrative rain, storms (gusting wind integrated exactly), blizzards (streaking snow), snow, hail (fall, hop, settle), splashes, dust, drips, condensation, stains and accumulating snow cover: closed-form particles per (seed, index, frame) for exact seeking and fixed memory, capped budgets, fades, reduced-motion variants that keep persistent results; SVG renderer for any 2D projection.

items.name: environmental-effects-three
items.title: Environmental Effects (Three.js)
items.description: Fixed-size buffers for rain streaks, soft snow and dust points, instanced water droplets and noisy-edged stain decals, updated per frame and ignored by inspection and section tools.

items.name: domain-home-effects
items.title: Home Effects
items.description: EnvironmentalEffects presets for a HouseLayout: rain, storm, blizzard, snow day (roof and ground cover on the real roof planes), hail, snowfall, a roof leak with a spreading ceiling stain, attic dust and window condensation.

items.name: scalar-field
items.title: Scalar Field Overlay
items.description: Supplied scalar fields (temperature, moisture, pressure) as calibrated colors, contours and threshold bands on any planar surface: explicit unit, source and fixed or dynamic domain, disclosed clipping, hatched missing data (never zero), keyframed fields over time, marching-squares contours; SVG renderer and legend. No physics simulation.

items.name: scalar-field-three
items.title: Scalar Field Overlay (Three.js)
items.description: The field as a translucent data texture on its 3D surface with contour lines, updated per frame and ignored by inspection tools.

items.name: inspect-then-quantify
items.title: Inspect Then Quantify
items.description: Composition recipe: overview, camera push to a semantic target, reveal by the asset's own action, anchored annotation, then the scene yields to a linked chart with its own reveal; beat plan with labeled holds (hold-short), target-in-frame check with the viewer's camera fit (target-offscreen), 16:9 and 9:16 layouts and an explicit final state; pure per frame.

items.name: failure-cascade
items.title: Failure Cascade
items.description: User-authored defect → effect → consequence graphs: validated ids, evidence, asset states and parts; cycle detection with the cycle path; unsupported-claim warnings; sourced cost ranges only, summed for revealed stages; longest-path staging in authored order; pure per-frame reveal with current state and focus for linked assets; SVG view for 16:9 and 9:16.

items.name: domain-home-section-2d
items.title: Home Kit 2D Section
items.description: SVG cross-section of a HouseLayout with the same semantic part IDs, anchors and service routes as the 3D build: layered walls and roof, foundations, soil, x-ray services, poché patterns, poses, and projected flows.

items.name: domain-home-floor-plan-2d
items.title: Home Floor Plan 2D
items.description: Architectural SVG floor plan of any storey from the same interior plan: walls, windows, door swings, bifolds, finishes, room labels with areas, furniture symbols and devices, tagged by semantic part ID.

items.name: craft-walk-camera
items.title: Walk Camera
items.description: First-person exploration hook: WASD/arrows, turn, run and drag-to-look with optional collision and floor callbacks, producing a plain camera pose for any viewer.

items.name: people-3d
items.title: People 3D
items.description: Realistic rigged 3D people (casual adult, contractor) with a shared action vocabulary: idle, talk, walk (in place, with measured ground speed), wave, look around, think and crouch. Ships the typed vocabulary and loader; the GLB models (MIT, Microsoft Rocketbox) are hosted by the consumer from assets/models/people with their license notice.

items.name: redaction-reveal
items.title: Redaction Reveal
items.description: Inline text with character-range redactions drawn as bars (text removed from the DOM), highlights for review, or overlay-only demonstrations; pure normalisation clamps, merges and reports invalid ranges; token-driven colours follow light and dark themes.

items.name: zone-boundary
items.title: Zone Boundary
items.description: Labelled dashed zones for SVG diagram overlays, marking where data stays inside a device or leaves to a third party; labels are measured in place and flagged when wider than their zone rather than truncated.

items.name: file-format-2d
items.title: File Format Objects
items.description: 2D file sheets with a validated, measured format badge (MOV, HEIC, WAV and similar) and a kind glyph, plus a conversion view from one format to another; badge labels choose ink or white by contrast.

items.name: location-pin-2d
items.title: Location Tag Drawings
items.description: 2D drawings of a photo or listing location tag: an exact pin, an approximate area, or a stripped tag, over an abstract street grid (no map data); coordinates are validated and shown only when supplied.

items.name: document-page-2d
items.title: Document Page States
items.description: 2D drawings of one document page in four stages: a scan with no text layer, a text layer added by OCR, a black box over text that is still present, and a flattened redaction; placeholder bars only, never real text.

items.name: audio-timeline-2d
items.title: Waveform and Clip Trim Timeline
items.description: SVG waveform of caller-supplied peaks with a kept selection and playhead, and a clip timeline with a width-aware time ruler, trim handles, dimmed removed regions and in/out labels that never overlap; illustrative peak generator for demos only.
